findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: set_form_fields, list_job_applications · Private data: upload_resume, draft_job_application, send_job_application · Public sink: upload_resume, draft_job_application, send_job_application, list_job_applications · Destructive: draft_job_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: set_form_fields, list_job_applications · Private data: upload_resume, draft_job_application, send_job_application · Public sink: upload_resume, draft_job_application, send_job_application, list_job_applications · Destructive: draft_job_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
